# From Fundraising to Equity: A Step-by-Step Guide to Blockchain-Based Reward Crowdfunding

Raising funds for new ventures are as complex as solving a puzzle in today's dynamics. Unconventional **crowdfunding methods** are trapped by bureaucracy, hidden fees, and slow processes. Fortunately, [blockchain technology](https://www.dpublication.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/F6-8416.pdf) has upgraded the industry with its **revolutionary** effort to provide an environment where startups launch their projects in a completely secure and transparent way. With the help of [Dopot](https://www.dopot.fi/), an innovative platform for **decentralized reward crowdfunding**, entrepreneurs and investors can experience a smoother, safer path to success.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)


## What is Blockchain-Based Reward Crowdfunding?

Let's say there's a business that sells sustainable garments for adults at reasonable prices. The owner needs [capital](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/c/capital.asp) to expand his business but is afraid to use traditional fundraising methods because of high fees and complex bureaucracy[[1](#ref-1)]. The owner tries innovative **blockchain-based reward crowdfunding** through **Dopot**, a decentralized platform designed to bring projects to life while minimizing risk and maximizing trust.

Now, the question arises: What is **Dopot** doing differently than its [competitors](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Z2gDlswsuw&t=10s)? With its cutting-edge blockchain technology, Dopot provides a secure and transparent environment where **funds allocation** is visible to investors, and no intermediary is involved with the startups. [Decentralized Autonomous Organizations](https://cointelegraph.com/news/daos-a-blockchain-based-replacement-for-traditional-crowdfunding) (DAOs) ensure participants are safe from any fraud or systematic manipulation through [smart contracts](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/smart-contracts.asp).

## Step 1: Creating the Campaign

To kick things off, the **startup** creates a crowdfunding campaign on **Dopot**. This is done using a [smart contract](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/smart-contracts.asp), a self-executing agreement in which the terms are automatically carried out when specific conditions are met [[2](#ref-2)]. The startup owner declares a **fundraising goal** of, let's say, 100,000 [DAI](https://www.kraken.com/learn/what-is-dai) and invites investors to back the project.

These are the investors who believe in the sustainable garments business and want to invest, let's say, 1000 DAI. With the help of **blockchain**, this investment is recorded on **Dopot**, which ensures that it can be tracked by everyone involved in the **fundraising process**. After the fundraising goal is achieved, the project moves forward, and **rewards** are handed out.

## Step 2: Fungible Tokens

Here's where the magic of **blockchain** happens. Each investor receives [fungible tokens](https://gammalaw.com/fungible-funding-using-nfts-for-crowdfunding/) representing their campaign investment in exchange for their contribution. Let's break it down:

- **Fungible Tokens** are like [digital dollars](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/d/digital-money.asp) that represent the value the investor has put in [[3](#ref-3)].
- Once the **fundraising goal** is met, these tokens will **transition** into [NFTs](https://www.investopedia.com/non-fungible-tokens-nft-5115211) **(Non-Fungible Tokens)**, shifting from investment to reward.

For instance, if the sustainable garments campaign hits the goal of 100,000 DAI, the investor's **fungible tokens** are automatically converted into an **NFT**, representing their **rewards**, such as an exclusive invitation to the garment's grand opening event or a special dinner for two.

## Step 3: NFTs

Once the fundraising target is reached, the investor's **fungible token** morphs into an **NFT**—a unique token that can't be replicated [[4](#ref-4)]. The beauty of **NFTs** is that they hold more than just [monetary value](https://capital.com/monetary-value-definition); they're also [collectible](https://opensea.io/category/collectibles).

For example, an investor who holds an NFT from the garments campaign might receive:

- **Special perks**, like discounts for future meals or VIP access to exclusive events.
- **The ability to trade** the NFT on [secondary markets](https://www.investopedia.com/how-to-buy-and-sell-nfts-6361693), where other interested buyers may want to obtain the reward.

This transition from fungible token to NFT brings even more value to the investor, offering the satisfaction of contributing to a successful project and a tangible, **tradeable** **asset**.

## Step 4: Trade and Refund Protection

Another unique feature of [Dopot](dopot.fi) is its built-in [security and protection](https://cmitsolutions.com/tribeca-ny-1166/blog/the-role-of-blockchain-in-data-security-and-integrity/) for investors. If the campaign doesn't reach its **funding goal**, the investor can request a refund of their **fungible token**. The token can be liquidated on the **secondary market** if the goal is met and the reward hasn't been delivered yet.

Thanks to its[smart contract](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/smart-contracts.asp)**, Dopot** ensures that every transaction is **secure**. If there are any disputes or issues, the **DAO** ([Decentralized Autonomous Organizations](https://cointelegraph.com/news/daos-a-blockchain-based-replacement-for-traditional-crowdfunding))—made up of **Dopot Token holders**—can intervene and make decisions that benefit the wider community.

Additionally, [Push Protocol](https://github.com/push-protocol) ensures smooth, encrypted communication between investors and startups, reducing the chance of fraudulent activities and offering complete transparency.

## Step 5: The Role of Smart Contracts and Decentralized Governance

One of the key advantages of **blockchain technology** is its ability to operate through **smart contracts**. These are self-executing contracts that ensure all terms are met automatically. Investors and startups don't need to rely on middlemen or intermediaries.

In cases where things don't go according to plan, the **DAO** votes to resolve the issue, ensuring that decisions are made fairly and transparently. The DAO's decentralized structure prevents a few bad actors from exploiting the system, making it a **secure**, **transparent**, and **trustworthy** way to raise funds [[5](#ref-5)].

## Why Choose Dopot?

Here's why [Dopot](dopot.fi) is the future of fundraising for small entrepreneurs and startups:

1. **Transparent**: With **blockchain technology**, every transaction is recorded and visible, eliminating hidden fees and surprises.
2. **Secure**: **Dopot** uses **smart contracts** to ensure every step of the process is carried out according to plan, with protection against fraud.
3. **Accessible**: Entrepreneurs with small ideas can raise funds without dealing with middlemen or banks, opening up new opportunities for **investment funding**.
4. **Rewarding**: By offering **NFTs** as rewards, **Dopot** turns traditional crowdfunding into an exciting, **collectible** experience for investors.

## Conclusion

The world of **fundraising** is evolving, and **Dopot** is leading the charge with its blockchain-powered reward crowdfunding platform. Using **fungible tokens** and **NFTs**, **Dopot** offers a secure, transparent, and efficient way for startups to raise capital and investors to get involved in exciting new projects. Whether you're a **small entrepreneur** with big ideas or an investor looking for **virtual capital**, **Dopot** is the platform to help make your dream a reality.
